{{Quote|Pardon my ignorance&mdash;I'm not an artist, and I'm not exactly familiar with the genre&mdash;but couldn't you substitute something for a piece of Adegan? Another energy source? Marilite, maybe, or pressure-treated halurium grains?|Jax Pavan, to Baron Vlaçan Umber|<ref name="Shadows" />}}
'''Halurium''' was a substance with a grain form that could be used as an energy source when it was pressure-treated. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] named [[Jax Pavan]] attempted to obtain a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] from one of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Vlaçan Umber]]'s [[Ves Volette]] [[light sculpture]]s, suggesting that the baron could use pressure-treated halurium grains as a replacement power source. However, Umber angrily denied Pavan's request, since removing a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] from one of the light sculptures would destroy it.

==Properties==
In its grain form, halurium was a substance that could be pressure-treated and used as an energy source.<ref name="Shadows" />

==History==
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> pressure-treated halurium grains were known to be useable as an energy source.<ref name="Shadows" /> Around that year,<ref name="TERC" /> [[Jax Pavan]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]&ndash;turned&ndash;[[Detective/Legends|investigator]], went to speak with [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Vlaçan Umber]] at the baron's [[Manarai Hills]] [[Vlaçan Umber's apartment|apartment]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] regarding the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of the [[light sculptor]] [[Ves Volette]]. Upon Pavan's arrival, [[I-5YQ]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[5YQ-series protocol droid|droid]] companion, noticed that the baron's Ves Volette [[light sculpture]]s utilized [[compressed energy crystal]]s similar to [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|those]] used in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], a traditional Jedi weapon that Pavan wanted to build. In the hopes of acquiring a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]], Pavan asked for one and inquired whether the baron could replace one of the sculpture's crystals with another energy source, such as pressure-treated halurium grains or [[marilite]]. The baron refused Pavan's request and was appalled, as the light sculpture would be destroyed if its crystal was removed.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
Halurium was mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="Shadows" />
